title: Overview: Use of Respiratory Support At Home in Children
official: An Overview of the Use of Respiratory Support At Home in Children - Patients and Families Point of View
summary: the primary outcome is to describe the perceived success of the use of the respiratory support from the parent's point of view
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children with respiratory support at home
* Age 0 to 18 (not yet passed) years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Palliative care
* Invasive ventilation
* High flow oxygen therapy
